skills.name: Falcon's Judgement
skills.effect: Deals smite damage to up to 3 enemy troops in a fan (Damage Factor 2500; every additional target reduces the damage dealt to each target by 15%). For the next 3 seconds, this commander's troop gains 15 extra Rage per second.

skills.name: Ironheart Vow
skills.effect: This commander's infantry units gain 10% Health, 30% Attack and 20% March Speed (always active, not context-locked).

skills.name: Flames of York
skills.effect: When attacking cities or strongholds: this commander's troop deals 20% more smite damage. Infantry units in this commander's troop deal 10% more damage against cavalry units. This commander's troop has a 50% chance to gain 30 extra Rage when dealing smite damage (once per second).

skills.name: Odin's Stratagem
skills.effect: If this commander is leading a rally attack: the rallied army takes 10% less combo attack damage. Whenever the rallied army is hit with a basic attack, it deals smite damage to the attacker (Damage Factor 200); if that attack is part of a combo attack, the rallied army also gains a 10% bonus to all damage dealt for the next 3 seconds. Up to 7 triggers per second, once per enemy troop per second. Cooldown: 2 seconds.

skills.name: Destined Defense
skills.effect: This commander's troop takes 10% less normal damage. If remaining units are below 50%, then their troop takes an additional 5% less normal damage.
